cards.ex: I decided to level with her about my financial problems.
cards.exUz: Men unga moliyaviy muammolarim haqida rostini aytishga qaror qildim.
cards.uzDef: Kimdirga to'g'ri va samimiy gapirmoq, haqiqatni aytmoq.

cards.ex: She's prone to exaggeration, so don't believe everything she says.
cards.exUz: U mubolag'aga moyil, shuning uchun uning hamma gapiga ishonmang.
cards.uzDef: Odatda yomon narsaga, tez-tez duch kelish yoki qobiliyatga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He's no shrinking violet; he'll happily tell you exactly what he thinks.
cards.exUz: U uyatchan emas; u sizga o'z fikrini mamnuniyat bilan aytadi.
cards.uzDef: Juda uyatchan va kamtarin odam, diqqat markazida bo'lishni xohlamaydigan.

cards.ex: He must be a glutton for punishment to keep working those long hours.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik uzoq soatlarda ishlashni davom ettirishi uchun jazoga o'ch bo'lishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarni yoki noxush vaziyatlarni takrorlashdan zavqlanadigan odam.

cards.ex: Even though she was nervous, she tried to play it cool during the interview.
cards.exUz: U asabiylashgan bo'lsa ham, intervyu paytida o'zini bosishga harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatda xotirjam va beparvo bo'lib ko'rinishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: It might be difficult now, but in the long run, it will be worth it.
cards.exUz: Hozir qiyin bo'lishi mumkin, lekin uzoq muddatda bunga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan, kelajakda, oxir-oqibatda.

cards.ex: His predecessor was so successful; he's a tough act to follow.
cards.exUz: Uning o'tmishdoshi juda muvaffaqiyatli edi; uning izidan borish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir yutuqlariga erishish juda qiyin bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: Before you start the project, make sure you get your ducks in a row.
cards.exUz: Loyihani boshlashdan oldin, narsalarni tartibga keltirganingizga ishonch hosil qiling.
cards.term: get your ducks in a row
cards.uzDef: Narsalarni tartibga solish, tayyorlash, rejalashtirish.

cards.ex: He tends to go against the grain in most of his decisions.
cards.exUz: U o'z qarorlarining ko'pchiligida odatdagiga qarshi chiqishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Odatdagiga yoki umumiy fikrga zid bo'lgan narsani qilish.

cards.ex: You need to have a thick skin to work in this industry.
cards.exUz: Bu sohada ishlash uchun qalin terili bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tanqidga bardoshli bo'lish, osonlik bilan xafa bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: As the manager, she gets to call the shots around here.
cards.exUz: Menejer sifatida u bu erda buyruq berishga haqli.
cards.uzDef: Qarorlarni qabul qilish va vaziyatni boshqarish.

cards.ex: She's such a social butterfly; she knows everyone in town.
cards.exUz: U juda faol odam; u shahardagi hamma odamni taniydi.
cards.uzDef: Barcha ijtimoiy tadbirlarda qatnashadigan va ko'p do'stlari bor odam.

cards.ex: He talks so much that nobody can get a word in edgewise.
cards.exUz: U shunchalik ko'p gapiradiki, hech kim gap qo'sha olmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa odam juda ko'p gapirganligi sababli gapirish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: It's important to keep your cool in stressful situations.
cards.exUz: Stressli vaziyatlarda o'zingizni bosishingiz muhim.
cards.uzDef: Xotirjam bo'lish, asabiylashmaslik yoki g'azablanmaslik.

cards.ex: She didn't bat an eye when I told her the bad news.
cards.exUz: Men unga yomon xabarni aytganimda u ko'z qirmadi.
cards.uzDef: Ajablanmaslik, hayron qolmaslik, hissiyot bildirmaslik.

cards.ex: He came from behind to win; he's a real dark horse.
cards.exUz: U orqadan kelib g'alaba qozondi; u haqiqiy kutilmagan g'olib.
cards.uzDef: Avvaldan ma'lum bo'lmagan va kutilmagan muvaffaqiyatga erishadigan shaxs.

cards.ex: She's a real mover and shaker in the business world.
cards.exUz: U biznes olamida haqiqiy ta'sirli shaxs.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p narsalarni amalga oshiradigan, ta'sir kuchiga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: I'm going out on a limb here, but I think he's innocent.
cards.exUz: Men bu erda tavakkal qilyapman, lekin menimcha u aybsiz.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli yoki mashhur bo'lmagan fikrni qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what she really means.
cards.exUz: Uning aslida nimani anglatishini tushunish uchun qatorlar orasidan o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aytilmagan narsalarni tushunishga harakat qilish, yashirin ma'noni anglash.

cards.ex: In business, sometimes you have to play hardball to succeed.
cards.exUz: Biznesda ba'zan muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun qattiq harakat qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun agressiv yoki murosasiz usullardan foydalanish.

cards.ex: He finally got a taste of his own medicine when someone lied to him.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat kimdir unga yolg'on gapirganda o'z jazosini oldi.
cards.term: a taste of your own medicine
cards.uzDef: O'zining boshqalarga nisbatan qilgan yomon harakatidan aziyat chekish.

cards.ex: She bends over backwards to help her friends.
cards.exUz: U do'stlariga yordam berish uchun jon kuydiradi.
cards.uzDef: Kim uchundir juda ko'p harakat qilmoq, yordam berish uchun juda ko'p ish qilmoq.

cards.ex: I didn't want to go to the dentist, but I had to bite the bullet.
cards.exUz: Men tish shifokoriga borishni xohlamadim, lekin qiyinchilikka chidashim kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin yoki yoqimsiz vaziyatni qabul qilish va chidash.

cards.ex: She's always smiling; she's a ray of sunshine.
cards.exUz: U doim kulib turadi; u nur sochuvchi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotga quvonch va baxt olib keladigan odam.

cards.ex: He's a real go-getter and is always looking for new opportunities.
cards.exUz: U haqiqiy ishbilarmon va doimo yangi imkoniyatlarni izlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadlariga erishish uchun energiya va qat'iyat bilan harakat qiladigan odam.

cards.ex: Don't be such a worrywart; everything will be fine.
cards.exUz: Bunday xavotirchi bo'lma; hamma narsa yaxshi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Tez-tez va haddan tashqari xavotirlanadigan odam.

cards.ex: It's good to let your hair down and have some fun sometimes.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan dam olish va o'yin-kulgi qilish yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Stressdan xalos bo'lish, erkin dam olmoq va o'yin-kulgi qilmoq.

cards.ex: We need to nip this problem in the bud before it gets worse.
cards.exUz: Bu muammo yomonlashishidan oldin uning oldini olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammo boshlanishidan oldin uni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: We decided to go to the beach on the spur of the moment.
cards.exUz: Biz to'satdan sohilga borishga qaror qildik.
cards.term: on the spur of the moment
cards.uzDef: Oldindan rejalashtirilmagan, o'sha zahotiyoq qilingan narsa.

cards.ex: He's such a doubting Thomas; he never believes anything you tell him.
cards.exUz: U shunday ishonchsiz odam; u sizning hech qanday gapingizga ishonmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga ishonish uchun dalil talab qiladigan odam.
